_readme: Discover South Lake Union - the neighbourhood association's own calendar.
One site, one endpoint; see mapsee_ingest_slu.py for why this is its own
adapter and not an ics/jsonld/tribe entry.

sites.name: Discover South Lake Union
_venues: The feed carries a street address on all but a handful of rows. These are
the exceptions, and they are here rather than guessed because
mapsee_supabase_sync geocodes street+city+region and DROPS anything with
no street - so a bare venue name silently vanishes. Both addresses were
read off the site's OWN directory (/location/<slug>/, 'Business Details'),
A venue that is not in this book and has no address in the feed is skipped
LOUDLY - the log line is how this book grows.
_skip_venues: 'Multiple Locations' is the neighbourhood's own label for a programme
that runs all over SLU (Summer in SLU, the passport programme). It is not
a place and there is no honest pin for it, so it is skipped QUIETLY -
unlike an unknown venue, this one is not waiting for anyone to fix it.
